circular.text:
Senior Frontend Engineer
Northwind Labs

We are hiring a senior frontend engineer to lead our dashboard team. You will own the design system, mentor two engineers, and ship weekly.

Requirements: 5+ years with React, strong TypeScript, accessibility knowledge.
Nice to have: GraphQL, data visualisation.

Apply by email with your CV and a short note.

materials.coverLetter:
Dear Northwind Labs hiring team,

I am applying for the Senior Frontend Engineer role. I have spent five years building accessible React and TypeScript interfaces, most recently leading the design system at Lumen Health. Your dashboard team’s focus on accessibility and weekly releases matches how I like to work.

I would welcome the chance to talk.

Ayesha Rahman

answers.question: What are your salary expectations (USD per year)?
Why do you want to join Northwind Labs?
answers.answer: I want to work on a product used by thousands of teams every day, and your public accessibility commitments match my own work on design systems.
